Private 4.9 Acre Multi-Lot Retreat with Charming Cottage

Discover a rare opportunity to own a multi-lot country retreat offering privacy, tranquility, and endless potential. Set on 4.9 acres across four separate lots, this unique property is ideal for expanding a family compound or creating a shared getaway for friends. Each lot is equipped with electric and access to their own private well, making future development simple and convenient.
Tucked away on a quiet dead-end road, you’ll enjoy peaceful nights and a true sense of seclusion. At the heart of the property sits a charming 684 sqft three-bedroom, one-and-a-half-bath cottage, full of warmth and character. Inside, you’ll find beautiful hardwood floors and inviting tongue-and-groove finishes throughout the walls and ceilings, creating a cozy, rustic atmosphere.
The property also features multiple outbuildings, providing ample storage for ATVs, tools, and outdoor equipment. A bonus bunkie offers additional space for guests, perfect as a mini cottage for visitors.
Surrounded by towering pines near the main cottage, the home is perched atop a hill, capturing refreshing breezes and scenic views. The lower lot, There is also a sister lot that is also available for sale.  LOT #2 of 1.7 acres with electricity on site. nestled among mature hardwoods, is already cleared and ready for a cabin, camper, or future home. 
Whether you’re looking for a private escape, a family compound, or an investment with room to grow, this property offers unmatched versatility in a peaceful natural setting.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Covered porch with enclosed kennel, SS Frige and gas stove, Wells (5), Septic, LP gas, Metal Roof, GMO’s and Timber Convey. 4.4 miles to Cuba, 8.7 miles to Olean, 9.5 miles to Portville, Taxes School $105 (2025) County $804 (2025). 
Buyer agent must be present on all showings. Do not send clients out without accompanying them.
